meta.name: email-creative-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "write the email", "draft subject lines", or "build email creative"; produces the pre-click unit — subject-line variants + preheader, body copy, one clear CTA, and a plain-text alt — message-matched to the destination page and claims-ledger-aware. Not for pre-scoring or ranking subject-line variants (spam/truncation/render pre-score) — use subject-line-lab; not for scoring the email or computing EQS — use email-quality-auditor; not for the multi-step flow — use email-sequence-designer; not for the A/B test plan — use send-experiment-designer. 邮件文案/主题行/邮件创意

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成邮件主题行、正文和行动号召
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为营销邮件撰写吸引人的文案和主题行。
copy.tagline_en: Generate email subject lines, body copy, and CTAs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need compelling copy and subject lines for marketing emails.

howto.what: 当用户要求写邮件、拟主题行或构建邮件创意时，Claude 会生成一组包含 3-5 个主题行变体、预览文本、正文、一个主要行动号召按钮和纯文本版本的邮件创意，并确保内容与目标落地页匹配。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求“写邮件”、“拟主题行”或“构建邮件创意”时触发。适用于 B2C 促销/生命周期、B2B 冷启动外联和新闻通讯等模式。

say.text: 为[优惠名称]写5个主题行和正文，目标页面是[URL]，促销模式。
say.note: Claude 会生成完整的邮件创意，包含主题行变体和正文。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to write an email, draft subject lines, or build email creative, Claude generates a set of 3-5 subject-line variants, preheader, body copy, one primary CTA, and a plain-text alternate, all message-matched to the destination landing page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to "write the email", "draft subject lines", or "build email creative". Covers B2C promo/lifecycle, B2B cold-outbound, and newsletter modes.

say_en.text: Write 5 subject lines and body for [offer], destination [URL], promo mode.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full email creative with subject variants and body.

say_en.text: Draft a cold-outbound email to [persona] for [offer]; personalize on [signal]; destination [URL].
say_en.note: Claude generates a personalized cold email.
